meta.title: Changing only the delivery date in the Reschedule dialog does not reschedule
gaps: The catalog cannot assert that the request body contains exactly delivery_schedules: [{delivery_by, uuid}] and no other fields.
No catalog step compares persisted round times before and after a delivery-only edit; reschedule_event's length check does not prove that the start and end stayed unchanged.
No catalog step observes reschedule pushes or notifications sent to vendors.
The prepared state's delivery date is unspecified, so the plan cannot guarantee that the chosen delivery date differs from its original value.

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ without creating or publishing another event.
Open Reschedule, edit only the delivery date, and press Ok; omit start to leave it untouched and disable the check intended for an actual reschedule.
Check that a successful request carries delivery schedules, using a broad path fragment because the endpoint is unspecified; this does not prove the exact body or absence of bid times.
